conflicts.description: Existing uncommitted changes include payroll, report, print, and workflow files.
conflicts.strategy: Do not revert. In execution, edit only files required by each TDD task and verify diffs before continuing.
conflicts.impact: Prevents overwriting unrelated work from earlier sessions.

conflicts.description: Backend and frontend both calculate payroll totals in several places.
conflicts.strategy: Add parity tests first, then either align formulas or mark frontend calculations display-only with backend as source of truth.
conflicts.impact: Reduces silent data drift between web, export, and backend.

conflicts.description: Some code paths treat deduction values as signed display values while others expect positive calculation magnitudes.
conflicts.strategy: Test source positive and negative values for every deduction boundary before implementation.
conflicts.impact: Prevents -(-amount), hidden negative deductions, and double subtraction.
